verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP ships a generic webhook destination. It sends events in realtime to any HTTP endpoint with a configurable method, URL parameters and JSON payload. Destinations can be filtered by event type, properties or SQL, have built-in testing and metrics/logs, and agents can set one up through the hosted MCP server. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, documented delivery semantics (retries, signing/verification).
